TierPassives.2: Shadow Form expands movement between dim light and darkness.

TierPassives.4: Resistance 10 to void and cold, shadow unaffected by normal sunlight, and counteraction through the Night DC.

AnimatedShadow.Name: Animated Shadow
AnimatedShadow.Description: Pipping positions his shadow as a tactical extension of his will.
AnimatedShadow.Detail1: At the start of the turn, place the shadow in a space within the Tier's range.
AnimatedShadow.Detail2: Once per round, an enemy adjacent to the shadow can be Off-Guard against an ally's Strike.

MirroredShadows.Name: Mirrored Shadows
MirroredShadows.Description: Shadow images divert attacks and retaliate when destroyed.
MirroredShadows.Detail1: Creates 2 images at Tiers I–II, 3 at Tiers III–IV, and 4 at Tier V.
MirroredShadows.Detail2: An attack against Pipping attempts DC 5; on failure it destroys an image and takes void damage, or cold against void immunity.

DarkWhisper.Name: Dark Whisper
DarkWhisper.Description: An ally within 30 feet gains a circumstance bonus to its next attack or save.
DarkWhisper.Detail1: The bonus is +1 until the start of Pipping's next turn.
DarkWhisper.Detail2: In complete darkness, Pipping can spend 1 additional SP to increase the bonus to +2.

VoidEchoes.Name: Echoes of the Void
VoidEchoes.Description: A failed save against an occult spell or unique ability restores 1 SP.
VoidEchoes.Detail1: Reaction, once per round, with a target within 30 feet.

LivingNight.Name: Song of the Living Night
LivingNight.Description: A sustained composition creates magical darkness that aids allies and hinders enemies.
LivingNight.Detail1: 30-foot presence with 10-foot darkness, increased to 15 feet at Tier III.
LivingNight.Detail2: Enemies in the darkness take –1 status to saves against Pipping; allies see normally.

RuinNote.Name: Note of Ruin
RuinNote.Description: An impossible note deals void damage with a basic Will save.
RuinNote.Detail1: On a critical failure, the target is also Frightened 1.

RestoringPulse.Name: Restoring Pulse
RestoringPulse.Description: The shadow closes the wounds of a willing living creature.
RestoringPulse.Detail1: In dim light or darkness, the target ignores Frightened 1 until Pipping's next turn.

BrokenMeter.Name: Broken Meter
BrokenMeter.Description: Pipping changes the perceived rhythm and forces safe movement.
BrokenMeter.Detail1: Will: failure moves 5 feet and makes Off-Guard; critical failure moves 10 feet and blocks reactions.

ShadowForm.Name: Shadow Form
ShadowForm.Description: Pipping teleports between areas of dim light or darkness.
ShadowForm.Detail1: Range 30 feet, 60 at level 9, and 120 at level 17.

VoidTouch.Name: Touch of the Void
VoidTouch.Description: An extension of the shadow passes through the target and deals void damage.
VoidTouch.Detail1: Basic Fortitude; failure deals persistent damage and critical failure also applies Enfeebled 1.

BlackOrderMantle.Name: Mantle of Black Order
BlackOrderMantle.Description: A reaction that reduces damage taken by Pipping or an ally.
BlackOrderMantle.Detail1: Reduction equals half level rounded up plus Charisma; in darkness grants temporary HP equal to Tier.

ShadowResonance.Name: Shadow Resonance
ShadowResonance.Description: Pain returns to the attacker as a dissonant note.
ShadowResonance.Detail1: Will: failure causes Frightened 1 and blocks reactions; critical failure causes Frightened 2.

NightEmanation.Name: Emanation of Night
NightEmanation.Description: A 15-foot emanation deals void or cold damage.
NightEmanation.Detail1: Basic Fortitude; failure causes Enfeebled 1 and critical failure causes Enfeebled 2 for 1 round.

RequiemPersist.Name: Requiem for Those Who Persist
RequiemPersist.Description: Up to three allies recover HP and gain protection for their next save.
RequiemPersist.Detail1: Each target gains +1 status to its next save before Pipping's next turn.

ShadowKing.Name: Shadow King
ShadowKing.Description: A living shadow domain creates difficult terrain for enemies.
ShadowKing.Detail1: Will once per use: failure makes Off-Guard; critical failure also causes Frightened 1.

EndingChorus.Name: Chorus of the End
EndingChorus.Detail1: Basic Will; failure causes Frightened 1 and critical failure causes Frightened 2 and Stupefied 1.

GentleNightLiturgy.Name: Liturgy of the Gentle Night
GentleNightLiturgy.Description: Pipping and allies within 30 feet recover HP.
GentleNightLiturgy.Detail1: Each target reduces Frightened, Sickened, or Stupefied by 1; this is a composition.

AbyssVoice.Name: Voice of the Abyss
AbyssVoice.Description: A shadow command forces the first actions of the target's next turn.
AbyssVoice.Detail1: Will with Incapacitation; failure forces one action and critical failure forces two valid actions.

BeyondForm.Name: Beyond Form
BeyondForm.Description: Pipping abandons physical form until the start of his next turn.
BeyondForm.Detail1: Gains flight, passes through creatures and objects, and resistance 15 except against force and spirit.

DeadSunEpitaph.Name: Epitaph of the Dead Sun
DeadSunEpitaph.Description: A 20-foot burst deals 14d6 void or cold damage and leaves magical darkness.
DeadSunEpitaph.Detail1: Basic Fortitude; failure deals persistent damage and critical failure also causes Enfeebled 2.

NightRefusesEnd.Name: The Night Refuses the End
NightRefusesEnd.Description: A reaction that prevents Pipping or an ally from dying.
NightRefusesEnd.Detail1: The target stays alive, heals 8d8 + Charisma, does not increase Wounded, and gains Doomed 1.

ForbiddenPerformance.Name: The Forbidden Performance
ForbiddenPerformance.Description: Allies become Quickened and enemies attempt Will in a 60-foot emanation.
ForbiddenPerformance.Detail1: Success makes Off-Guard; failure causes Slowed 1 and critical failure causes Slowed 2.
